text:
Type: round braided jute rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: natural braided jute, off-white bands
Colors: warm natural tan, off-white
Shape: large circle, spiral braided texture from the center, double off-white border stripes near the edge, flat and earthy
Feel: natural, warm, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, rattan, white walls, linen textiles; coastal, boho or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: nuLOOM Rikki Braided Border Jute Area Rug, 8' Round, Off-white
product.description: This inherently beautiful jute rug is left in its natural tan color. It will bring a neutral, classic accent to a low-traffic area such as a bedroom. Classic casual style Made of 100% jute Timeless look with durability 8' Diameter Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
